summary: Tested free trial mock interview flow end-to-end. Landing FreeTrialCTA renders with correct data-testids. Backend /api/free-trial/start returns 200+trial_id for valid emails and 400 for invalid emails, /provision correctly requires Supabase Bearer auth (401 otherwise). Full UI flow: email submit -> /free-trial/{tid} -> auto Supabase signup -> POST /provision (200) -> navigate to /interview-sims -> hub renders UNLOCKED (hub-progress-banner visible, hub-locked-banner NOT visible) with all 5 firms (JPM, MS, GS, Motilal Oswal, Kotak) and firm-apply-jpmorgan enabled/clickable. All 4 core acceptance criteria PASS. Recovery-button code path inspected (renders inside hub-locked-banner only when vv_free_trial_id is in localStorage) but not runtime-executed because the primary flow produced an unlocked hub as expected.

integration_issues.issue: After signup+provision, /interview-sims initially shows a generic Suspense loader for ~10-14 seconds before InterviewSimHub mounts (heavy badge/enrollment prefetch chain in AuthContext/Sidebar makes 20+ supabase requests before /api/interview-sim/overview fires). Flow WORKS, but perceived latency is high for a marketing-driven free trial and users may bounce. Consider deferring badge preload or showing a skeleton with the hub testid so users see progress.

action_items: (Optional/perf) Reduce cold-start latency on /interview-sims after fresh signup — 10-15s to first paint of InterviewSimHub is high for a trial funnel.

(Optional) The device-uniqueness 409 fires immediately if any user from the same IP-hash bucket already started a trial. In shared-office / campus wifi scenarios this could block legitimate trial signups — consider softening to fingerprint-only or adding a bypass.
critical_code_review_comments: free_trial_endpoints.py provision endpoint is idempotent (checks existing enrollment/user_module/user_sessions before insert) — good.

FreeTrialPlayerPage: if supabase.auth.signUp succeeds without an immediate session (email confirmation ON in some Supabase projects), the code sends the user to /login with prefill. Works, but message 'Please log in with the existing account for this email' is misleading when the account was just created. Consider distinct copy for 'confirm email' vs 'already registered'.
InterviewSimHub inline recovery button: uses window.location.reload() after provision — good simplicity. But swallows 401/500 into a JS alert; should use toast for consistency.

FreeTrialCTA blocks retry on same laptop via localStorage 'vv_free_trial_used' BEFORE calling backend — if user clears storage they can retry; that's already covered by server-side IP/fingerprint uniqueness (409). OK.
test_credentials: Generated throwaway emails trialtest-{unix_ms}@valuevade.test during test. mocktest@valuevade.test / MockTest2026! confirmed available per request but not needed.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a handful of free_mock_trials rows (one per fresh email). Playwright test created one Supabase user (trialtest-1787593308068@valuevade.test) with M20 enrollment + provisioned sessions. Consider cleaning up occasionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note the IP/fingerprint 409 on /api/free-trial/start once any trial has been created from the test container's IP. To retest UI end-to-end, EITHER wait for a new pod (fresh IP) OR seed localStorage directly with an existing trial_id + fresh email, then visit /free-trial/{tid} to exercise signup+provision+hub-unlock. Existing trial_id known-good: 34ad3651-6c56-4ca0-8cba-3762faf66714. Hub takes 10-15s to render on first fresh-account load — always wait_for_timeout(15000) after nav to /interview-sims before asserting hub-progress-banner. The 5 firm-apply testids are: firm-apply-jpmorgan, firm-apply-morganstanley, firm-apply-goldmansachs, firm-apply-motilaloswal, firm-apply-kotak.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. The flow works end-to-end as designed.
